# Carl Macabales

> Carl Emmanuel Macabales is an AI and software engineer in Quezon City, Philippines, and a 2026 Mapúa University graduate (BS Computer Science, AI specialization). He builds the model and the product around it: published ML research in medical imaging and clinical NLP, and full-stack products on Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Stellar payments. He is open to AI/ML and full-stack roles, freelance work, and research collaborations.

The full portfolio is one page: https://cemmacabales.com/

## Projects

- [Centient](https://beta.centient.work): A human-feedback platform for AI teams. Contributors compare two AI answers, say why one is better, and are paid in USDC on Stellar as soon as the answer is accepted. Won a $5,000 Instawards grant. Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Stellar. [Source](https://github.com/cemmacabales/centient)
- [Edge Exercise Coach](https://github.com/cemmacabales/pose_est_v2): Classifies exercises and grades form in real time on a Raspberry Pi 5, using BlazePose landmarks and a dual-head LSTM trained on 451,638 augmented 30-frame windows, with a RAG chat that explains what to fix.
- [AF Guideline Assistant](https://doi.org/10.1109/CSPA68262.2026.11517831): Answers clinical questions from the 2024 ESC atrial fibrillation guidelines with MedCPT embeddings, FAISS search, and BGE reranking over three quantized open models (Llama 3, Phi-3, Qwen3). Published at IEEE CSPA 2026. [Source](https://github.com/cemmacabales/AFIB)
- [Renal CT Detection](https://kidney-abnormality-detection.streamlit.app/): Finds cysts, stones, and tumors in axial and coronal CT slices with YOLOv12, trained on 14,761 curated and augmented scans. Presented at IEEE ICIPCN 2026 at Kathmandu University, Nepal. [Source](https://github.com/cemmacabales/KidneyDetection)
- Pink Raft: No-code payment flows on Stellar. Drag in triggers and actions, and a live Soroban contract deploys in under 60 seconds. 1st runner-up at the Stellar Hackathon (May 2026); Carl was the full-stack and AI integration lead. Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Soroban.
- [Read My Face](https://readmyfaceai.netlify.app): Reads seven facial expressions from a webcam in the browser with face-api.js and answers each with GSAP-driven visual feedback.
- [MyApt](https://myapthome.netlify.app): A property management dashboard for tenants and units on live Firebase data.
- [Petchingu](https://github.com/cemmacabales/petchinguuu): A pet care app for health records, vet appointments, and daily routines, built with React, TypeScript, and Appwrite.

## Research

- [Clinically Oriented Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Kidney Abnormality Instance Segmentation in CT Images](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICIPCN67432.2026.11438968): 2026 6th International Conference on Image Processing and Capsule Networks (ICIPCN), IEEE. Co-author.
- [Open-Source LLMs for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Question Answering: A RAG Framework Based on the 2024 ESC Atrial Fibrillation Guidelines](https://doi.org/10.1109/CSPA68262.2026.11517831): 2026 22nd IEEE International Colloquium on Signal Processing & Its Applications (CSPA). First author.

## Experience

- Lead Developer, Artisam Labs (contract), September 2026 to present: leads the build of Centient.
- Software Engineer Intern, The Blocklabs, April to June 2026.
